title: Russian interpretation-layer evaluation contexts and draft rubric
status: DRAFT rubric authored from food_intake_calculation_v1.json; contexts and thresholds await product-owner approval. Scores the model's raw ParserOutput, not the bounded resolver.
scoring_notes: This set validates hypothesis #1: can the live model turn casual Russian food messages into correct structured proposals.

Each case is scored only on signals objectively checkable from ParserOutput: consumption vs non-logging, number of add_food actions, presence/absence of clarifications (unresolved fields), extracted quantities, and candidate identity selection.
known_gaps record context/schema limitations that are NOT model failures (e.g. no profile slot for 'кофе как обычно'); the runner reports them separately and does not penalize the model for them.
clarification: 'required' means a question is the correct behavior; 'forbidden' means a clean message must save without asking; 'optional' means either is acceptable.

draft_thresholds.note: Draft only. False clarifications are the primary friction risk, so clarification_accuracy is weighted in the go/no-go read.

cases.source_text: Завтрак: яичница яйцо + белок 1:1, 115 гр, хлеб 52, тунцовая намазка 45, масло 7 гр, кофе как обычно
known_gaps: 'кофе как обычно' is a per-user profile shortcut; the parser context has no profile slot, so the model cannot resolve it. A missing/unresolved coffee is expected, not a model failure.
The explicit 1:1 egg/white ratio is normalized to 57.5 g egg and 57.5 g egg white; the backend validates the split and sum.

cases.source_text:
Обед в столовой: два куриных бедра без кожи, граммов 120
Овощи тушеные баклажан, кабачок, фасоль, граммов 100
Салат овощной без заправки 100 гр
known_gaps: 'граммов 120' is an approximate amount; whether the chicken 120 g is edible meat or includes bone is genuinely ambiguous, so a clarification is the correct behavior.

cases.source_text: Персик 100 гр и одна ягодка физалиса
known_gaps: 'одна ягодка физалиса' has no gram amount; the backend applies a standard single-berry estimate. The model is expected to leave the physalis quantity unresolved or report the count, not invent grams.

cases.source_text: Завтрак 2 яйца, хлеб цз 43, паштет 40, масло сливочное 3, кофе как обычно
known_gaps: 'паштет' matches two saved recipes, so a clarification is the correct behavior.
'кофе как обычно' is a profile shortcut with no context slot; unresolved coffee is expected.
'цз' -> 'цельнозерновой' and the category-0 egg rule are backend normalizations.
The source spelling 'Брезель' differs from the catalog 'брецель'; matching it tests spelling tolerance.

cases.source_text: Сыр 20 грамм, тот же что раньше

candidates.name: сыр (тот же, что в прошлый раз)

known_gaps: 'тот же что раньше' is a history reference; the parser context has no history slot, so the last cheese is supplied here as a pre-resolved candidate. A real live run needs a history-reference context extension (a finding for #1).

cases.source_text:
Картошка и батат запеченные 1:1, всего 120 грамм
Масла к картошке было 3 грамма
known_gaps: The explicit 1:1 ratio is normalized to 60 g potato and 60 g sweet potato; retain the explicit 3 g oil and do not add hidden cooking oil.

cases.source_text:
Две запеченные куриные ножки с кожей и костью, всего 150 грамм
Масло к курице не добавляла
known_gaps: 150 g is gross weight including skin and bone; edible weight needs a separately weighed bone mass, so a clarification is the correct behavior. The model must not add cooking oil given the explicit 'не добавляла'.
